description: Manages and retrieves information related to user profiles and their associated data within the system.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserData
endpoints.description: Retrieves the comprehensive data for the currently authenticated user.
example_uses: How can I get my own user profile information?
Show me all the data associated with my current login.
I need to fetch the details of the user who is currently logged in.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the system needs to display or utilize information about the user who is currently authenticated and making the request.

endpoints.name: GetUserByEmail
endpoints.description: Retrieves user information based on a provided email address.

email.description: The email address of the user to retrieve.

example_uses: Can I get the details of a user by their email address?
I need to look up a user's information using their email.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to find specific user data and you only have their email address as an identifier.
